beats.say: This is Day 1 of AI agents that pay you back.

scene.sub: AI agents that pay you back

beats.say: Today it's the Subscription Agent. It finds every subscription you forgot you're paying for.

scene.name: subscription-agent
scene.desc: Finds every recurring charge, flags price hikes, and writes your cancel messages.

beats.say: You upload 3 months of bank statements, black out the account numbers, and type monthly sweep.
It finds every recurring charge, even the weird names, yearly renewals, and free trials that quietly turned paid.
Then it adds them up. Per month, and per year.
Every month it checks again, and flags anything new, any price hike, and anything you canceled that's still charging.
Then it writes the cancel message for you, ready to send.

scene.text: Write the cancel message for the gym.

rows.t: Confirm in writing, no more charges.

beats.say: One tip: cancel where you signed up, and screenshot the confirmation.

scene.text: Cancel in the same place you signed up (app store, website). Screenshot the confirmation. Canceling your card doesn't cancel the subscription.

beats.say: Follow so you don't miss Day 2. And comment SUBS, and I'll send you the full setup straight to your DMs.
